concerns: Listing path: WP REST API (browser navigate to the JSON, httpx fallback, 3-try retry). Not DOM scraping. 24 records; 14 kept (10 dropped: 5 past, 5 webinars/exams).

Skipped on purpose: webinars (academy.esaic.org, a JS learning platform, no fee/venue data) and EDAIC Part II exam sittings. Both have dates in the API; if wanted, they could be added as online workshops from the API record alone.

Endorsed/external events (9) redirect from esaic.org straight to the organiser site, so they are built from the API record (dates, place). booking_url in the detail is the organiser site; source_url stays the esaic.org URL. Their fees are NOT parsed: a trial parse of one third-party congress turned 'registration includes' bullets into tiers, so pricing is [] and the remediator's external-site hop is relied on (coverage warnings PRICE_SAME_SITE_LINK for KoreAnesthesia and PRICE_TEXT_ON_PAGE for the EEG Bootcamp are these).

Coverage checklist: same-site registration sub-page verified for Euroanaesthesia (grid at /2027/registration/, read via one fetch_html hop); fee pages for own masterclasses are on the esaic.org page; image/PDF fee tables, poster competitions and CFP PDFs not seen on the ESAIC-owned pages. Euroanaesthesia fees are excl. 25% Danish VAT (stated on the page, not in the tier label). Euroanaesthesia 2028/2029 pages are 'mark your calendars' only.

SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE fires in the harness for Euroanaesthesia 2027 and KoreAnesthesia (call for abstracts on page, opening Nov 2026 / no date); the pipeline's _ensure_submission_info covers it on the loaded page. Family detail_from_html leaves submissions to that step by design.
Specialty is forced to 'Anaesthetics' for every row (PREFER_DEFAULT_SPECIALTY) because the title classifier mislabelled an airway congress as Leadership & Management.
Shell count identical (14) across two runs; harness --force-fallback not meaningful (browser-first).
Possible shared change: wordpress_generic.location_from_ld crashes when JSON-LD location.name is a list (hit on aasld.org, worked around in aasld.py with a retry that strips ld+json).
